unstuck_said.text: Filed additive issue #1 on the temporal-payment-corridor-workshop repo (github.com/alexandreroman/temporal-payment-corridor-workshop/issues/1): proposed a Nano (XNO) settlement lane to the cross-border payment workshop, with nano-invoice (dhyabi2/nano-invoice) as the open-source helper that binds a payment to the order it pays for (Nano has no memo field).
